options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the action to perform. C(list) to display the characteristics of a paging space. C(create) to add an additional paging space. C(modify) to modify a paging space. C(remove) to remove a paging space. C(activate) to activate a paging space. C(deactivate) to deactivate a paging space.

options.name: activate_all_ps
options.description: Specifies that all the paging spaces available need to be activated.

options.name: activate_immediately
options.description: If set to true, specifies to activate the paging space immediately.

options.name: checksum_size
options.description: Specifies the size of the checksum to use for the paging space, in bits. If not specified, by default it takes the value as 0.

options.name: include_summary
options.description: Used with I(action==list) If set to true, specifies that the summary characteristics of all paging spaces are to be given. This information consists of the total paging space in megabytes and the percentage of paging space currently assigned (used).

options.name: list_all
options.description: Used with I(action==list) When set to true, It specifies that all the paging spaces should be listed

options.name: logical_partitions
options.description: Specifies the size of the paging space and the logical volume to be made in logical partitions. If you are trying to create non-nfs paging space, you need to provide this attribute.

options.name: logical_partitions_add
options.description: When I(action == modify), specifies the number of logical partitions to add.

options.name: logical_partitions_substract
options.description: When I(action == modify), specifies the number of logical partitions to substract.

options.name: nfs_server_hostname
options.description: Specifies the NFS server where the ServerFileName resides. It is required to specify this attribute, in case of I(ps_type == nfs) and I(action == create)

options.name: nfs_server_pathname
options.description: Specifies the file which will be used for the NFS paging of the system. It is required to specify this attribute, in case of I(ps_type == nfs) and I(action == create) This file must exist and be exported correctly to the client that will use the file for paging.

options.name: paging_space_configured_at_sub_restart
options.displayName: Paging Space Configured At Sub Restart
options.description: Specifies that the paging space is configured at subsequent restarts.

options.name: ps_helper_name
options.description: Specifies the name of paging space helper program that needs to be used. When C(ps_chars == ps_helper), It is required to provide I(ps_helper_name)

options.name: ps_list
options.description: Specifies the list of paging spaces that need to be activated or deactivated.

options.name: ps_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the paging space.

options.name: ps_type
options.description: Specifies the characteristics of the paging space. C(lv) specifies that characteristics of only logical volume paging spaces are to be given. C(nfs) specifies that the characteristics of only NFS paging spaces are to be given. In case of C(action == list), the heading of the output will be changed to display the host name of the NFS server and the path name of the file that resides on the server that is being used for NFS paging. C(ps_helper) specifies that a helper program is to be used.

options.name: pv_name
options.description: Specifies the physical volume of the I(volume_group) on which the logical volume is to be made.

options.name: use_on_next_swapon
options.description: Specifies that the I(checksum_size) will be used for the next swapon of the paging space. This option has no effect if I(checksum_size) is not specified or paging space is not swapped on.

options.name: use_ps_at_next_restart
options.description: Specifies to use a paging space at the next system restart.

options.name: volume_group
options.description: Specifies the name of the volume group to be used for creating the paging space. If you are trying to create non-nfs paging space, you need to provide this attribute.
